title: Model
spec: Create a new coordinate system by setting the Euler angles to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and the translation vector to zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop by creating a line from the origin to the point (0.03, 0.0), then from there to (0.03, 0.03), next to (0.0, 0.03), and finally back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.003, 0.003) to (0.027, 0.003), then to (0.027, 0.027), next to (0.003, 0.027), and back to (0.003, 0.003). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.03. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the model will be a length of 0.03 units, a width of 0.03 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.03, 0.03, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# Define the inner rectangle
inner_rectangle = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.024, 0.024, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False)).translate((0.003, 0.003, 0))

# Cut the inner rectangle from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_rectangle)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are -90.0, 0.0, -90.0, which corresponds to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model
print(r)

import cadquery as cq

# Square hollow tube along the X axis
length = 0.75
outer = 0.03
wall = 0.005

r = (
    cq.Workplane("YZ")
    .rect(outer, outer)
    .rect(outer - 2 * wall, outer - 2 * wall)
    .extrude(length)
)
